layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Vessel segmentation is critically essential for diagnos-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing a series of diseases, including coronary artery disease

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and retinal disease. However, annotating vessel segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation maps of medical images is notoriously challenging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: due to the tiny and complex vessel structures, leading to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: insufficient available annotated datasets for existing super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vised methods and domain adaptation methods. The sub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tle structures and confusing background of medical images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further suppress the efficacy of unsupervised methods. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this paper, we propose a self-supervised vessel segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion method with adversarial learning. This method learns

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel representations by training an attention-guided gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erator and a segmentation generator to simultaneously syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thesize fake vessels and segment vessels out of coronary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: angiograms, respectively. The method further applies the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pretrained segmentation generator for coronary vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation and retinal vessel segmentation. We also build

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: XCAD, the first X-ray angiography coronary vessel segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation dataset. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed method's effectiveness against existing segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation methods on multiple datasets, including the XCAD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset, DRIVE dataset, and STARE dataset.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As the most common heart disease, coronary artery dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ease is one of the leading causes of death in the world.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Atherosclerosis in the coronary artery hinders blood from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: normally flowing into the heart, eventually leading to a heart

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attack. Among various imaging modalities, X-ray angiog-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: raphy is taken as a gold standard for coronary artery dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ease diagnosis. As X-ray angiography can quickly display

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: small vessel branches with a high resolution, it has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more widely utilized in medical diagnosis for determining

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the presence, location, degree, and scope of coronary artery

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stenosis. It is crucial but challenging to accurately estimate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: subtle vessel structures from coronary angiograms. To min-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: imize the ionizing radiation exposure of patients and medi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal personnel, low-power X-ray is used during X-ray coro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nary angiography, usually leading to noisy and low-contrast

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary angiograms. However, such images make it hard

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to distinguish vessels from the background artifacts¹ that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: share similar appearances with vessel structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: During X-ray coronary angiogram acquisition, a special

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cardiac catheter is utilized to inject contrast agent into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary artery. With the contrast agent taking effect, blood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessels gradually emerge, leaving a sequence of coronary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: angiography images under the X-ray. In such a coronary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: angiography sequence, the first frame with no contrast agent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: injected is the mask frame, without any vessels shown. On

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the contrary, the frame with a fully injected contrast agent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is considered as the contrast frame. Note that in this paper,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we use coronary angiogram to indicate the contrast frame

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in particular. Our objective is to segment vessels out of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary angiograms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Existing segmentation methods can be classified into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: four main categories: traditional methods [17, 23], super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vised methods [8, 25], domain adaptation methods [3, 31],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and unsupervised methods [4, 15]. Traditional methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are typically based on predefined rules that require signif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: icant expertise and manual model tuning, leading to lim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ited model expressiveness and generality. Supervised meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods require a massive amount of annotated data for train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing, though public large-scale annotated vessel datasets are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: practically unavailable. The complex vessel structure con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sists of numerous tiny branches that easily fade into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image background artifacts, making the manual annotation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process extremely laborious and time-consuming, even for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: professional medical experts. The effectiveness of domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adaptation methods is largely dependent on the quality of

layout_dets.text: 1Note that this paper uses artifacts to represent the factors (e.g., di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aphragm, catheter, and bones) making segmentation difficult.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotated source domain dataset and constrained by the gap

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: between the source domain and target domain. Existing un-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervised segmentation methods for natural images, such

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as animals and flowers, can hardly work on medical images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: due to their thorny characteristics—numerous tiny branches

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and confusing background artifacts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Inspired by self-supervised methods that learn represen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tations from large-scale unsupervised data [6, 24], we ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ploit coronary angiography images' specific characteristics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and design a self-supervised vessel segmentation method.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Existing self-supervised methods learn useful representa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions for solving other tasks by constructing pretext tasks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on unsupervised data. However, no existing self-supervised

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods are designed for segmentation tasks due to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: complexity of semantic segmentation. We observed that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: there are two kinds of images in coronary angiography im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ages: images with vessels (i.e., coronary angiograms) and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images without vessels (i.e., mask frames). According to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this characteristic, we propose to learn self-supervised ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sel representations by simultaneously training two adversar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ial networks that synthesize fake vessels on mask frames

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and segment vessels out of coronary angiograms. These

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learned vessel representations can be easily applied to mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiple vessel segmentation tasks by directly using the pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained model.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Without labeled vessel segmentation maps, we design a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fractal synthetic module for self-supervised learning. Frac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tals synthesized by the fractal synthetic module are further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: utilized to guide the generation of vessels and serve as seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation maps of synthetic fake coronary angiograms. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propose an attention-guided generator to confirm that ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sels of synthetic fake coronary angiograms matches input

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation maps. The idea of cycle consistency in Cycle-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GAN [39] is applied to segmentation tasks. In our frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work, the two adversarial networks for vessel synthesis and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation form a cycle to produce reconstructed coro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nary angiograms and reconstructed segmentation maps. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further propose to use segmentation loss to enforce the con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sistency between segmentation maps and reconstructed seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation maps.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To support our research and facilitate the work of other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: researchers, we are the first to create an X-ray angiogra-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phy coronary artery disease (XCAD) dataset. The XCAD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset contains 1621 mask frames and 1620 coronary an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: giograms in the training set, and 126 coronary angiograms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotated by experienced radiologists in the testing set. Ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perimental results on the XCAD dataset demonstrate the ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fectiveness of the proposed method on coronary vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation. Moreover, our method shows competitive per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance with other retinal vessel segmentation methods on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the DRIVE dataset [34] and STARE dataset [13].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The main contributions of this paper are summarized as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • To our best knowledge, we are the first to design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a self-supervised method for vessel segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our method solves vessel segmentation tasks of both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary angiograms and retinal images, with self-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervised vessel representations learned from unan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notated coronary angiography images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We build a large-scale XCAD dataset and will release

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it to public.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • The proposed method eliminates the limitations of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing segmentation methods and shows remark-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ably competitive performance on the XCAD dataset,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DRIVE dataset, and STARE dataset.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. Traditional Methods for Vessel Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Traditional vessel segmentation methods [17, 23] require

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designing predefined rules for specific images. Khan et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [17] designed several filters for retinal image denoising, en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hancement and finally for vessel segmentation. Memari et

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: al. [23] proposed to firstly enhance retinal images using

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contrast limited adaptive histogram equalisation and sev-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eral filters. Then they utilized a genetic algorithm enhanced

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial fuzzy c-means method for extracting an initial ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sel segmentation map. Finally the segmentation is further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refined by an integrated level set approach.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Traditional methods with manually designed strategies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can only be used for the specific task and have poor scala-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bility. Methods for retinal vessel segmentation cannot solve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the coronary vessel segmentation problem. However, our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method successfully solves the problems of both retinal ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sel segmentation and coronary vessel segmentation. More-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over, our method is scalable and easy to be utilized.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2. Supervised Methods for Vessel Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: At the early stage of supervised vessel segmentation, Es-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fahani et al. [25] used Top-Hat transform to enhance the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input angiograms. Then, the vessel regions can be recog-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nized by training Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with quantities of patches. Khowaja et al. [18] applied bidi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rectional histogram equalization on the inverted green chan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nel to enhance the retinal images in supervised retinal ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sel segmentation. Soomro et al. [33] utilized fuzzy logic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and image processing tactics for pre-processing, and they

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: removed the noisy pixels for post-processing. These meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods require specifically designed pre-processing and post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: processing strategies.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Mask images are utilized to distinguish vessels from ar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tifacts and remove the influence of background artifacts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Yang et al. [37] utilized the DeepMatching method [30]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for the registration between the mask frames and contrast

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frames, then used both of them as multi-channel inputs to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: provide enhanced information of the vessel structure. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance of this method highly relies on the registration

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for paired mask frames and contrast frames. On the con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trary, our method does not need to use paired mask frames

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and contrast frames.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UNet [32] is mostly used as the backbone of vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation [8, 33, 36]. Fan et al. [8] proposed an octave

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UNet for accurate retinal vessel segmentation, which adopts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: octave convolution for multiple-spatial-frequency features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning. Yang et al. [36] studied the segmentation of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: major vessels in X-ray coronary angiograms with UNet on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotated datasets. Supervised methods require complex

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel annotations. Our method alleviates the vessel anno-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation burden by self-supervised learning.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3. Domain Adaptation Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Domain adaptation [1] transfers knowledge from the an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notated dataset in the source domain to the unannotated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset in the target domain. An adversarial network [9]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is utilized for domain adaptation in many semantic segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation tasks [12, 5]. Adversarial training generates domain-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: invariant features through domain confusion. During this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process, cycle consistency is usually employed for preserv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing structures [11, 38].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In medical image segmentation, Dou et al. [7] stud-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ied domain adaptation between CT and MRI by proposing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a plug-and-play adversarial domain adaptation network to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: align feature spaces of both domains presenting significant

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain shift. A domain adaptation method named MMD

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [3] was proposed for brain tissue segmentation by minimiz-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the maximum mean discrepancy between the source do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main and target domain. YNet [31] extended classification-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based domain adaptation techniques to segmentation net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: works by regularizing the encoder features.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: These methods fail to handle tasks that lack of large-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale annotated datasets in a close source domain. However,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our method does not require any annotated dataset as source

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.4. Unsupervised Segmentation Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Xu et al. [15] proposed a method named Invariant Infor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation Clustering. It can automatically partition the input

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images into clusters that are recognizable as different se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mantic classes. Another method named ReDO [4] utilized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an adversarial architecture to extract the object mask of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input, then redrew a new object at the same location with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different textures or colors. Because segmentation objects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and backgrounds of medical images are very similar and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: difficult to distinguish, these methods are less effective on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: medical image segmentation. In contrast, our method takes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: into account the characteristics of medical images and out-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perform these methods on vessel segmentation of coronary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: angiograms and retinal images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.5. Self-supervised Representation Learning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Self-supervised learning methods construct pretexts to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learn representations from large-scale unsupervised data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Spatial representations are learned by predicting the rela-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive positions between two image patches [6, 26]. Simi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lar studies designed pretext tasks for image inpainting [28]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: super-resolution [21] and image colorization [20] by ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plying transformations on original images. Different from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: single pretext tasks, Ren et al. [29] learned more general-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: izable high-level visual representations from multi-task in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cluding depth, surface normal and instance contour. Misra

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. [24] employed Siamese networks to input multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video frames in parallel and learn temporal representations

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by shuffling image sequences. Xu et al. [35] learned both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial and temporal information by sorting the order of 3D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clips. SpeedNet [2] predicted the speed of the video from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the input of full video sequences. These learned represen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tations are proved to be helpful to action recognition, im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age classification, and object detection tasks, by finetuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the pretrained model on annotated datasets. However, it is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hard to design a suitable pretext task and learn useful repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations for complex semantic segmentation. We propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to use fractal synthetic module for self-supervised learning.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our method learns representations for vessel segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by adversarial vessel synthesis and segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Overview

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method. We generate fake coronary angiograms and vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: 3.2. Fractal Synthetic Module

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fractals are simple graphic patterns rendered by math-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ematical formulas. It is demonstrated that fractals can as-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sist learning image representations for recognizing natural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scenes and objects. Kataoka et al. assisted natural image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: understanding by pretraining classification networks on an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: automatically generated Fractal DataBase [16]. However,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one limitation of fractals is that the rendered fractal patterns

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consist of discrete points without textures, which limits the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: application of fractals. Therefore, we propose to synthetic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fractals as segmentation maps and use attention-guided gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erator to add realistic textures on these fractals.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: black background, we synthesize fractals that look similar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to vessels by literately drawing rectangles on a black back-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground and adding local distortions on it. We design a frac-

layout_dets.text: 4.4.2 Ablation Study

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We conduct the ablation study to evaluate the impact of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different architectures and loss functions on the segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion quality. The results are shown in Table 2. We test the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: following four setups.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Base. In this setup, we use CycleGAN [39] as the base-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: line, which deals with unpaired image-to-image translation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of two domain X and Y. We use synthetic segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion maps generated by fractal synthetic module as domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: X and coronary angiograms as domain Y. Although this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: baseline can coarsely segment vessels out of coronary an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: giograms, the segmentation quality is not high and synthetic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fake coronary angiograms are very different from real coro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nary angiograms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Base + Attention. The attention-guided generator helps

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the network make use of the self supervised information in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary angiograms. Moreover, the segmentation quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improves while the synthetic fake coronary angiograms be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: come more realistic.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Base + Segloss. Replacing the cycle consistency loss with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation loss extensively improves the performance of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the vessel segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Base + Attention + Segloss. The best performance is ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tained when both the attention-guided generator and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation loss are used. Note that the network cannot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve unsupervised vessel segmentation without fractal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthetic module. Besides, removing the segmentation loss

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: substantially degrades the performance, same as does re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: moving the attention-guided generator. We therefore con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clude that fractal synthetic module, attention-guided gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ator and segmentation loss are all critical to our results.

layout_dets.text: 4.4.3 Retinal Vessel Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed self-supervised method solves multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel segmentation tasks after learning vessel representa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions from coronary angiograhy. We further demonstrate the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effectiveness of our method on retinal vessel segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the DRIVE dataset and STARE dataset, directly using

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the pretrained model. We present retinal vessel segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion results of the existing methods in Table 3. The visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation results of our method are shown in Figure 3.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Compared with traditional methods, the AUC of our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method improves by 0.3% on the DRIVE dataset. Although

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the overall performance of our method is slightly worse than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the traditional methods, our method solves multiple kinds of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel segmentation tasks. Moreover, the proposed method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is convenient and does not require complex processing. Tra-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ditional methods are inconvenient and specifically designed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for retinal vessel segmentation. When compared with su-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervised methods, the performance of the proposed method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decreases less than 7% on all of the four metrics. Besides,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our method is totally unsupervised and does not require

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: troublesome annotations. Our method surpasses unsuper-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vised methods to a large extent. Quantitatively, our method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: brings more than 20% improvements on accuracy, 25%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improvements on sensitivity, 6% improvements on speci-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ficity and 16% improvements on AUC on both DRVIE and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: STARE dataset.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we propose a self-supervised vessel seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation method, which has advantages against existing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation methods. The proposed method applies ad-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: versarial learning to learn vessel representations from unan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: notated coronary angiograms and mask frames. We fur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ther successfully utilize these learned representations for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coronary vessel segmentation and retinal vessel segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. Extensive experimental results on the XCAD dataset,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DRIVE dataset, and STARE dataset demonstrate the effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiveness of the proposed method.
